image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a wet, rocky substrate. The subject displays the characteristic eight overlapping dorsal plates embedded in a textured girdle. A small barnacle is attached to the upper portion of the chiton's back. The lighting is specular, highlighting the wet texture of the organism and the rock.
